_readme: Key = the display mesh's object name AS THREE.js's GLTFLoader names it at runtime (it strips dots '.' from the raw Blender/glTF node name to keep animation-binding paths valid — e.g. 'monitor.001_low_monitor_0' in Blender becomes 'monitor001_low_monitor_0' here). Value = an image file placed in public/screens/. Swap the file (same name) or change the value to update what plays on that screen — no code changes, no rebuild of the .glb needed.
